name: Pre-registration
definition: Rule text, window and gates frozen in git before the window opens
pass_criteria: Registration commit exists and predates the first scored result

name: Minimum sample
definition: Enough scored bets that a win rate is not noise
pass_criteria: 300 scored bets for provisional listing; 5,773 to separate 55% from 52.4% at 80% power

name: Walk-forward comparison
definition: Out-of-sample scoring on a chronological holdout
pass_criteria: Model beats its own pre-registered baseline on the holdout
observed: side +22%, totals -12% (both estimators worse than constant mean)

name: Proper-score qualification
definition: Benchmark-relative Brier skill with a game-cluster lower bound and a multiplicity adjustment
pass_criteria: Lower bound above 0 after adjusting for the number of trials
observed: n=14 on the only holdout; no strategy has a qualifying sample

name: Price provenance
definition: A dated, licensed operator price for every market claimed
pass_criteria: Opening and closing capture with a hash and timestamp per market

name: Depth-source verification
definition: One verified depth-order route for all 32 clubs before the depth feature is built
pass_criteria: Route (a) club depth pages verified 32/32, or route (b) an official snap-count source
observed: 0 of 32 clubs verified; jersey/experience/salary route explicitly rejected

name: Ablation reproducibility
definition: Two identical models with and without availability features, chronological holdouts
observed: no verified availability feature exists to ablate

name: Demotion
definition: A live strategy returns to paper on a numeric trigger
pass_criteria: Rolling 200-bet benchmark-relative lower bound falls to 0

name: Joint evidence for combos
definition: A combo may be ranked only with a directly validated joint probability and the operator's void/push rules
observed: neither present; multiplying marginals is invalid under dependence

name: Calibration of designations
definition: Play rate per designation with confidence intervals before it becomes a feature
pass_criteria: CI excludes the base rate for the wrong reason or is stable across seasons
observed: n=0 seasons archived; 16 of 253 report rows carry a game designation at all
